_comment: DEVELOPMENT FIXTURE - NOT LIVE DATA. Verbatim snapshot of a real response from GET https://api.vedur.is/quakes/events?format=csv&system=seiscomp covering a 7-day window. Stored as the raw upstream CSV on purpose so the fixture provider runs it through the same normalizeQuakesCsv() as production. Only reachable when EARTHQUAKE_SOURCE=fixture, which the provider registry refuses in production builds.
